name: @ahura/agent-core
description: Pure agentcore loop core — the multi-step agent loop (model turns + tool dispatch), message mapping, tool interface, and shared types. ZERO runtime deps and ZERO I/O: everything is injected (callModel, dispatchTool, priceStep, onStep). One source of truth consumed by both the CF Worker gateway / Next control-plane (via lib/agent barrels) and the k8s agent-runner (file: dep). Prevents inline-vs-durable drift (§6).
